## Projects

### RacketChess

A chess engine written entirely in Racket — pure recursion for move validation, check, and checkmate detection, with a graphical interface built on Racket's own graphics library.

Technologies: Racket, Lisp, Functional Programming, Game Logic
Repository: https://github.com/1594-adrs/RacketChess

### CSV2Binary-DBMS

A file-based database engine in C that converts CSV data into binary records and answers analytical queries — sorting, binary search, currency conversion — without ever loading the full dataset into memory.

Technologies: C, File I/O, Binary Search, Merge Sort
Repository: https://github.com/1594-adrs/CSV2Binary-DBMS

### PrereqFlow

An interactive Streamlit app that models a university curriculum as a prerequisite graph — visualize it, plan semesters under credit limits, edit courses live, and track progress, backed by 50 passing tests.

Technologies: Python, Streamlit, PyVis, pytest
Repository: https://github.com/1594-adrs/PrereqFlow

### Portfolio

This site. Built with Angular 21, standalone components, and signals. Scroll-reveal animations, lazy-loaded routes, and a custom IntersectionObserver directive. Deployed on GitHub Pages.

Technologies: Angular, TypeScript, CSS, HTML
Repository: https://github.com/1594-adrs/1594-adrs.github.io

## Web Projects

### Graphing Calculator

Plot functions, compute integrals, and visualize solids of revolution in real time.

Technologies: Angular, Canvas API, Custom Parser
URL: https://1594-adrs.github.io/web-projects/calculator/
